construction: Incidence graph of the split Cayley generalized hexagon H(11) (354312 vertices, 12-regular, diameter 6). Hermitian spread of 1332 pairwise opposite lines; subdivided: 8 edges on 480 spread lines, 7 edges on 840 spread lines (9720 new vertices); on every line the points whose cyclic label lies in a fixed difference cover of Z_12 stay untouched. New vertices at one spread line form a clique; the remaining slots carry external pattern edges. The pattern graph is invariant under a subgroup of order 120 of the regular group SL(2,11) of the good spread lines; of its 11 line orbits 4 carry 8 subdivided edges per line and 7 carry 7.
base_graph: the point-line incidence graph of the split Cayley generalized hexagon H(11), a standard object, too large to attach here
labelling: the point, line and new-vertex numbers in the files below refer to my own numbering of H(11), so these files describe the construction rather than let you rebuild it from your own copy of the hexagon; I am glad to send the base graph or the full adjacency list of the record itself, in whatever format is convenient

files_in_this_package.spread_lines: deg12_diam6_n364032_spread_lines.txt (the 1332 lines of the Hermitian spread, one line number per row)
files_in_this_package.pattern: deg12_diam6_n364032_pattern_graph.adj (the edges among the new vertices)
